newsitem.title: UK: UK shares edge to record close as Dow hold gains.
newsitem.headline: UK shares edge to record close as Dow hold gains.

text.p: UK shares set a record close for a second day on Wednesday, reassured as Fed chief Alan Greenspan denied trying to talk down Wall Street in last week's testimony to U.S. legislators but unsettled by a sharp fall in gilts.

With markets still cautious ahead of further Greenspan testimony later today, the FTSE closed just 2.4 points higher at 4,360.1, with gainers in a five to four majority. The Dow held an early gain to be up 46 or 0.6 percent as London closed.
In a mostly mixed session, oil stocks helped power the FTSE to an intraday record of 4,367.3, with Enterprise Oil up 14p at 625 and BP up 5-1/2p at 693.
